title: From Verifiable Dot to Reward Chain: Harnessing Verifiable Reference-based Rewards for Reinforcement Learning of Open-ended Generation
authors_zh: Yuxin Jiang, Yufei Wang, Qiyuan Zhang, Xingshan Zeng, Liangyou Li, Jierun Chen, Chaofan Tao, Haoli Bai, Lifeng Shang
paper_type_zh: 训练数据选择或奖励设计论文
best_for_zh: 研究后训练数据消费与优化目标的读者。
one_line: RLVRR turns high-quality references into an ordered reward chain for RL on open-ended generation.
RLVRR 将高质量参考答案转换为有序奖励链，用于开放式生成的强化学习。
why: It makes the training-data decision inspectable.
inclusion_reason: It changes how a training record, selection decision, or reward signal is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open-ended tasks lack one unambiguous final answer, so outcome-only verification is sparse and vulnerable to reward hacking. RLVRR turns high-quality references into an ordered reward chain for RL on open-ended generation. In a real post-training pipeline, this uncertainty is costly because every retained example consumes tokens, optimization steps, and evaluation capacity. A useful intervention must therefore specify not only a desirable outcome, but also which record-level decision changes before training begins.

The paper asks which training records or reward signals should be consumed under a fixed post-training budget. The paper treats this as a decision about the training surface: the model sees a different subset, environment, or reward-bearing record, and its reported outcome should be compared with a matched alternative rather than with an unrelated model.

开放式任务缺少唯一明确的最终答案，因此只验证结果的信号稀疏且容易被奖励黑客利用。 RLVRR 将高质量参考答案转换为有序奖励链，用于开放式生成的强化学习。 在真实的后训练流水线中，这种不确定性代价很高，因为每个被保留的例子都会消耗词元、优化步骤和评测能力。因此，一个有用的干预不仅要说明期望结果，还必须明确训练开始前改变了哪一种记录级决策。

论文追问在固定后训练预算下，应当消费哪些训练记录或奖励信号。 论文把它视为关于训练表面的决策：模型会看到不同的子集、环境或带奖励记录，报告出的结果也应与匹配的替代方案比较，而不是与无关模型比较。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
It extracts reference-derived content requirements and style checks, rewarding their ordered satisfaction during RL. This changes the training decision rather than only describing a corpus. The important unit is not an abstract notion of “quality,” but a concrete object that can be consumed by training: an instruction pair, a generated task, a reference-derived requirement, or a verifier-backed trajectory. The method makes the signal attached to that object explicit enough to rank, revise, generate, or reward it.

The selection or reward rule is model- and setting-dependent, so it must be evaluated under a matched recipe. This framing also separates the claim from generic model scaling. If the same backbone, budget, and optimizer are held fixed, any difference can be attributed more directly to how records are selected, structured, or rewarded. That is the connection between the paper and a reproducible training-data decision.

它从参考答案提取内容要求和风格检查，并在强化学习中奖励这些要求按序满足。 这改变的是训练决策，而不只是描述一个语料库。 重要单位不是抽象的“质量”概念，而是可被训练消费的具体对象：指令对、生成任务、由参考答案导出的要求，或由验证器支持的轨迹。该方法把附着在对象上的信号明确到足以排序、改写、生成或奖励它。

选择或奖励规则依赖模型和设置，因此必须在匹配的训练配方下评估。 这种表述也把论文主张与通用模型扩展区分开来。若固定相同的基模型、预算和优化器，观察到的差异就能更直接归因于记录如何被选择、组织或奖励。这正是论文与可复现训练数据决策之间的联系。

title: Method
方法
html:
The official paper describes the source records, applies the stated selection or verification procedure, and trains with the resulting object. The implementation should be read as a pipeline rather than a single score: collect or construct candidate records, attach the stated signal, make a keep/revise/reward decision, and train under a fixed recipe. Each stage can change the final data distribution, so reproducing only the final loss or optimizer is insufficient.

Official implementation material is linked so the record, signal, and training recipe can be inspected and reproduced. For reuse, preserve the source mixture, model version used to produce the signal, thresholds or quotas, and the unit of verification. These details decide whether a later experiment consumes the same training object or merely uses a method with the same name.

官方论文说明了来源记录，应用所述选择或验证步骤，并用得到的对象训练。 应把实现理解为一条流水线，而不是一个单独分数：收集或构造候选记录，附上所述信号，作出保留、改写或奖励决策，再在固定配方下训练。每一阶段都可能改变最终数据分布，因此只复现最终损失或优化器并不充分。

官方实现材料已链接，使记录、信号和训练配方可被检查和复现。 复用时应保留来源混合、用于产生信号的模型版本、阈值或配额，以及验证单位。这些细节决定后续实验消费的是同一个训练对象，还是只使用了同名方法。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across more than ten benchmarks it reports stronger results than SFT with ten times more data and releases code and data. The relevant evidence is strongest when the candidate pool, base model, token or rollout budget, and evaluation protocol are held constant. Under that design, the comparison tests the proposed training-data decision instead of conflating it with a larger teacher, a longer schedule, or a different benchmark suite.

The reported comparison supports the claimed use in its evaluated settings, but it is not a universal claim about every model or source pool. The reported numbers should still be read as evidence for the paper’s stated domains and recipes. They do not by themselves prove that the signal is calibrated, that it transfers unchanged to another language or data source, or that the released records are free of benchmark overlap.

在十多个基准上，它报告了优于使用十倍数据的 SFT 的结果，并发布代码和数据。 当候选池、基模型、词元或 rollout 预算以及评测协议保持不变时，相关证据最有力。在这种设计下，比较检验的是所提训练数据决策，而不会与更大的教师模型、更长训练日程或不同基准套件混淆。

所报告的比较支持其在被评估设置中的用途，但不是关于每个模型或来源池的普遍主张。 报告出的数字仍应被理解为对论文所述领域和配方的证据。它们本身并不证明该信号已经校准、能原样迁移到另一种语言或数据来源，也不证明发布记录不存在与基准的重叠。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier work commonly uses a coarser record-level filter or terminal signal; this work makes the listed training decision explicit. The distinction from adjacent work is operational. A paper that only proposes a new optimizer, inference trick, or evaluation metric need not alter the records consumed during training. Here the contribution changes the data-selection boundary, the generated training object, or the reward contract attached to a rollout.

Its contribution is the changed consumer, selection rule, or reward interface, not the generic optimizer alone. This novelty should be evaluated by asking whether another practitioner could implement the changed decision and observe its effect under controlled training. It is not a claim that the surrounding model architecture or every auxiliary component is new.

既有工作通常使用更粗粒度的记录过滤或终局信号；本文使所列训练决策显式化。 与相邻工作的区别在于操作层面。只提出新优化器、推理技巧或评测指标的论文，不一定改变训练中被消费的记录。这里的贡献改变的是数据选择边界、生成出的训练对象，或附着在 rollout 上的奖励契约。

其贡献是改变训练消费者、选择规则或奖励接口，而不只是通用优化器。 评价这一新意时，应询问另一位实践者能否实现这个被改变的决策，并在受控训练下观察其效果。这并不是说周围的模型架构或每个辅助组件都具有新颖性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The result depends on the paper’s source mixture, implementation choices, and evaluation protocol. The selection or reward signal can inherit bias from its generator, verifier, or scoring model, and a release may have unreported license, duplication, or benchmark-overlap risks. Before deployment, audit representative retained and rejected records, reproduce the matched baseline, and check whether the assumed verification condition still holds in the target domain.
结果依赖论文中的来源混合、实现选择和评测协议。选择或奖励信号可能继承生成器、验证器或评分模型的偏差，发布版本也可能存在未报告的许可证、重复或基准重叠风险。部署前应审计有代表性的保留与拒绝记录，复现匹配基线，并检查目标领域中假定的验证条件是否仍然成立。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a post-training system needs a documented decision about which records to consume or how to reward them. Start from the official artifact, fix the base model and budget, compare the stated rule with a simple random, uniform, or outcome-only baseline, and report both capability and failure metrics. Treat the method as a reproducible experimental intervention, not as an automatic certificate that selected data are truthful or safe.
当后训练系统需要对消费哪些记录或如何奖励它们作出有文档说明的决策时，可使用这项工作。应从官方 artifact 开始，固定基模型和预算，将所述规则与简单的随机、均匀或仅结果基线比较，并同时报告能力与失败指标。应把方法视为可复现的实验干预，而不是被选数据真实或安全的自动证书。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep four questions in mind: what is the atomic training record, what signal is attached to it, what exact decision changes its consumption, and what controlled comparison supports that decision? The paper is most useful when these four answers are preserved with the artifact links and implementation version. The first replication check is whether the same record-level intervention still improves the target objective under a matched budget.
阅读时记住四个问题：最小训练记录是什么，记录附着了什么信号，哪个确切决策改变其被消费的方式，以及哪一种受控比较支持该决策？当这些答案与 artifact 链接和实现版本一同被保留时，论文最有用。首个复现检查应是：相同的记录级干预在匹配预算下是否仍能改善目标。
